tools.name: property-intelligence_overview
tools.description: Retrieve available planning and heritage information for a property using UPRN, coordinates, or postcode. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/overview. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_constraints-check
tools.description: Check specific planning constraints (conservation areas, listed buildings, flood risk, etc.) for a location. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/constraints/check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_planning-search
tools.description: Search planning applications by local planning authority, date range, or other filters. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/planning/search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_site-report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive site report combining constraints, brownfield land, and planning applications. Price $0.10 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/site/report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_listing-extract
tools.description: Read price, rent, address, and room counts from caller-supplied listing text or one public listing page. Missing figures stay blank. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/listing-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_details-normalize
tools.description: Return one listing record from supplied fields or printed text. A supplied value is kept when it conflicts with the printed value. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/details-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_description-analyze
tools.description: List bedrooms, area, amenities, and marketing phrases only where those words are printed. Marketing words are not a quality score. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/description-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_area-context
tools.description: Look up the OpenStreetMap place for a supplied address or coordinates. Planning, crime, ownership, and valuation stay unavailable. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/area-context. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_location-features
tools.description: List schools, hospitals, pharmacies, supermarkets, stations, and parks that OpenStreetMap places within 500 metres. A missing feature is not treated as absent. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/location-features. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_amenities-extract
tools.description: Keep amenities printed in the description separate from amenities copied from the request. Caller amenities are not checked against the property. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/amenities-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_listing-duplicate-detect
tools.description: Compare at least two supplied listings. The same address is a duplicate. The same price, currency, and bedroom count is only a possible match. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/listing-duplicate-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_rent-yield-calculate
tools.description: Divide the supplied annual rent by the supplied price. Monthly rent is multiplied by 12 only when the period is month. The result is not a valuation. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/rent-yield-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_investment-metrics
tools.description: Calculate net yield, price per square metre, loan, and cash flow only from supplied price, rent, costs, deposit, and mortgage rate. No loan-to-value is assumed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/investment-metrics. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-intelligence_due-diligence-report
tools.description: Combine the observed listing, supplied assumptions, and any OpenStreetMap place or nearby features. Planning, crime, ownership, and valuation stay unavailable. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-intelligence/due-diligence-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "property-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: property-intelligence_overview, property-intelligence_constraints-check, property-intelligence_planning-search, property-intelligence_listing-extract, property-intelligence_description-analyze, property-intelligence_location-features · Private data: property-intelligence_details-normalize · Public sink: property-intelligence_overview, property-intelligence_constraints-check, property-intelligence_planning-search, property-intelligence_site-report, property-intelligence_listing-extract, property-intelligence_details-normalize, property-intelligence_description-analyze, property-intelligence_area-context, property-intelligence_location-features, property-intelligence_amenities-extract, property-intelligence_listing-duplicate-detect, property-intelligence_rent-yield-calculate, property-intelligence_investment-metrics, property-intelligence_due-diligence-report · Destructive: property-intelligence_overview, property-intelligence_constraints-check, property-intelligence_planning-search, property-intelligence_site-report, property-intelligence_listing-extract, property-intelligence_details-normalize, property-intelligence_description-analyze, property-intelligence_area-context, property-intelligence_location-features, property-intelligence_amenities-extract, property-intelligence_listing-duplicate-detect, property-intelligence_rent-yield-calculate, property-intelligence_investment-metrics, property-intelligence_due-diligence-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
